items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t think I ever met him. But I went with Prestige. I remember I had a low-income contract with them.

ctx.x: Do you remember your encounter with Bob Weinstock, the head of Prestige...
I don’t think I ever met him. But I went with Prestige. I remember I had a low-income contract with them.
To be specific, $250 apiece for the first two records, and $350 for the remaining four.
